operations: Measure genuine source alpha and visible bounds
Use largest 8-connected alpha component bounds only when it contains at least 99% of foreground pixels; otherwise retain full bounds and flag review
Extract that rectangle, retaining every original pixel inside it
Resize mechanically to the guide alpha bounding box
Place on the unchanged 1536-square guide canvas
Trim to visible bounds plus 12 pixels
Assemble those individual final images at their fixed anchors
